reads.label: 1A
reads.note: Vertical leader from the boxed label rises past a horizontal crossing line (y~1863) and ends at the lower tip of the plunger rod at the bottom of the playfield.

reads.label: 1C
reads.note: Horizontal leader from the boxed label crosses the left rail structure and the outlane area, enters the leftmost (tilted) target rectangle through its lower-left edge and ends inside it near its bottom corner.

reads.label: 2A
reads.note: Horizontal leader at y~766 passes the left wall and the curved rail and ends where it meets the long slanted rod/line that runs from the lower right corner of the large rectangular structure down to the small post at about (397,855). Nothing continues beyond that line.

reads.label: 2C
reads.note: Horizontal leader crosses the left rail structure and ends inside the second target rectangle (counting from the left), a tilted rectangle, just right of its left edge.

reads.label: 3A
reads.note: Printed number with a small solid arrowhead above it pointing up; the arrow tip touches the underside of the long diagonal bar below the large round assembly (bar runs from about (530,850) to (655,915)). Arrow tip used as the leader end; the bar centre is about (595,888).

reads.label: 3C
reads.note: Long diagonal leader from the boxed label runs down and to the right across the left lane structure and the curved guides and ends inside the middle (third) target rectangle, near its top.

reads.label: 4A
reads.note: Horizontal leader at y~833 ends where it meets the thin slanted line (from about (306,816) to (314,850)) at the top of the left lane, just above the spoked-roller assembly at about (300,870).

reads.label: 4C
reads.note: Horizontal leader from the right boxed label passes the right-hand structures and the corner of the tilted fifth target, and ends inside the fourth target rectangle (just right of centre of its width), at about x=663.

reads.label: 5A
reads.note: Vertical leader from the boxed label descends into the double-ringed circular part in the top-left area and ends inside the outer ring, above the small rectangular slot inside it. Circle centre is about (383,255).

reads.label: 5C
reads.note: Horizontal leader from the right boxed label passes the right-hand ramp structure and ends inside the rightmost (fifth) tilted target rectangle.

reads.label: 6A
reads.note: Dashed horizontal leader from the right boxed label; the visible solid and dashed parts end at about x=958, left of the right wall lines, just short of the shooter lane tube at about x=935-942. The dashes point at the shooter lane, so the part is probably the launch lane device, but the visible end is the gap before the lane.

reads.label: 6C
reads.note: Top boxed 6C, left of two leaders that fan out from the box and descend to the big round structure at the top; this leader ends on the horizontal line at y~194 just inside the arcs at the top of the round structure (centre about (595,268)).

reads.label: 6C
reads.note: Top boxed 6C, right leader of the pair; ends on the same horizontal line at y~194 under the arcs at the top of the big round structure.

reads.label: 6C
reads.note: Right boxed 6C, upper leader: runs up and to the left across the right wall lines and the slanted ramp lines and ends inside the tall rounded rectangle (x 817-868, y 880-938), just inside its right edge.

reads.label: 6C
reads.note: Right boxed 6C, lower leader: runs left and slightly down, crossing the shooter lane and ramp lines, and ends inside the arrow-shaped part near (850-900, 1030-1110), just inside its left upper edge.

reads.label: 8A
reads.note: Horizontal leader from the boxed label crosses the left lane lines and ends under the spoked wheel symbol, inside the dashed oval below it (wheel centre about (372,400), oval about x 343-400, y 413-457).

reads.label: 8C
reads.note: Bold number printed with no leader at the top of the long right-hand ramp structure, just left of the thick ramp tubes; the ramp entrance arrow shape is at about (705,920) below it. It is unclear which part it names.

Bold number printed with no leader, right of a curved path drawn with two solid arrowheads that leads from the spoked wheel at about (755,553) to a second spoked wheel at about (827,637). The number most likely names this wheel pair or the path they sit on.
reads.verifier_note: Callout 9 has no leader of its own but two arrowheads beside it: one points left at the spoked flasher-dome symbol centred here and the other points down at a second dome symbol (added as its own read). The reader recorded the printed number's centre; the curator moved the read to the dome the first arrow marks.

reads.note: Top occurrence: bold number with a solid arrowhead pointing right; the arrow tip touches the left end of the small horizontal rectangular bar at the top left (bar about x 310-355, y 215-235), left of the circular part 5A.
Lower occurrence: bold number with a solid arrowhead pointing right at the spoked wheel symbol; the arrow tip is at about (344,397) and the wheel centre is about (372,400).
Bold number with a solid arrowhead pointing left; the tip touches the right edge of the long slanted bar (flipper-like bar from about (320,975) to (305,1105)) at the left lane.
Bold number printed with no leader, in the upper right between the ramp lines; the nearest parts are a cluster of small circles at about (765-800, 460-480) to its left. Unclear which part it names.
Bold number with no leader, upper left of the left pop bumper (bumper centre about (538,657), about 90 px away). Probably names that bumper, but no leader proves it.
Circled label with a horizontal leader that crosses the left rail structure and ends inside the small oval part on the left slingshot assembly (oval about x 390-425, y 1385-1403).

Bold number with no leader, above and between the left and right pop bumpers; closest is the right pop bumper (centre about (725,641), about 100 px away). Probably names that bumper, but no leader proves it.
Circled label with a horizontal leader that crosses the right ramp tubes and rail and ends inside the small oval part on the right slingshot assembly (oval about x 750-773, y 1387-1402).
Bold number with no leader, just above the bottom pop bumper (centre about (642,782), about 90 px below). Probably names that bumper, but no leader proves it.

Bold number with no leader, printed over the narrow tapered lane walls of the shooter lane at the right edge; the lane walls (about x 935-1000) run down from the lane entrance. Unclear which part it names.
Second arrow of callout 9, pointing down at this spoked flasher-dome symbol.
reads.verifier_note: Added by the curator: the reader recorded callout 9 once, at the printed number, although it carries two arrowheads to two dome symbols.
